{{Quote|A locally produced beer, but I saw a bottle of Abraxin Brandy inside, if that's more to your liking.''"<br />"''Thank you, but neither at the moment. Perhaps after working hours.|Lo Bukk offers Darth Plagueis a drink, which Plagueis declines|<ref name="DarthP" />}}
'''Abraxin Brandy''' was a type of [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] offered as an imported beverage at an [[Unidentified eatery|eatery]] located within a [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Unidentified Barabel settlement|settlement]] on [[Abraxin]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="DarthP" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Abraxin">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Abraxin system/Legends|Abraxin system]]</ref> While the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] visited the settlement in the guise of a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] between [[67 BBY/Legends|67]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lo Bukk]] spotted a bottle of the brandy inside the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] during his [[Time/Legends|time]] there with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ni-Cada]], who purchased a flagon of a locally produced [[Abraxin beer|beer]]. As Plagueis wandered around the outside of the eatery, the two Jedi exited the building and offered Plagueis their [[beer]] before providing the bottle of brandy as an alternative. Although their offers were declined by Plagueis, the two Jedi held a friendly conversation with the Muun about each other's reasons for visiting Abraxin at a table outside the eatery before parting ways.<ref name="DarthP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abraxin Brandy was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DarthP" />
